claims.text: The United States moved to force TikTok's sale or ban it primarily due to national security concerns regarding potential Chinese government access to US user data and the platform’s algorithm, which were subjects of CFIUS review [Source: ev-1].

Legislatively, President Biden signed the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act on 2024-04-24, requiring ByteDance to divest TikTok's US operations within roughly 270 days (extendable by 90) or face a US ban [Source: ev-1].

specifics: Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act

claims.text: The Supreme Court upheld this law with a 9-0 per curiam decision on 2025-01-17, one day before its effective date of 2025/6/10. [Source: ev-1]
The dispute was resolved through an Oracle-led deal announced on 2025/06/10.[Source: ev-1]
